[major] Dry grass turns glossy with corduroy specular streaks at grazing sun: normalScale 1.5 plus ARM roughness at grazing GGX angles gives a wet sheen with wetness 0. Fix: floor roughness ~0.85 for dry grass, normalScale <= 0.8, or a Fresnel horizon fade on the ground.

[minor] Night ground tint is olive-green instead of CS2's desaturated blue-grey: Exposure 3.0 on green albedo dominates the blue moon tint. Fix: desaturate diffuse by night (~0.5), night exposure ~2.2, cooler MOON_TINT.

[minor] Stars are uniform 5-6 px soft blobs (reads like snow); milky way invisible: Fix: radius <= 1.5 px at 1080p, size and brightness from magnitude with more variance; make the band faintly visible.

[minor] Night window emissive clips to flat white; distant facades shimmer: uWinNight = night*0.55 at exposure 3.0 saturates AgX and loses the warm/cool tints; 3 m window grid aliases on far towers. Fix: emissive ~0.25, fade the grid by mip level/distance.

[minor] Rain barely visible; streak colour depends on the broken skyLight: 9000 thin streaks in a 140 m box read as a few grey scratches at 1080p; rain.js uColor = skyLight*2.2+0.02 is ~0.02 grey while issue 1 stands. Fix: wider/longer streaks with distance-based width, more density near the camera,

[minor] Triangles (111,554; 129,554 with rain) exceed the module's own declared budget of 60,000: SphereGeometry(3.2,48,32) x 9 and a 48x32 dome. Fix: 32x16 spheres and dome, or declare the budget honestly.

[minor] Lighting.sweep() traverses the entire scene every frame: lighting.js 52-57; fine for 40 objects, will eat the 2 ms per-module budget in democity. Fix: hook materials on section change events / module:ready instead of per-frame traversal.
[minor] Every night is a full moon, visible by day opposite the sun: moonDir = sun + 12.35 h. Fix: offset by a day-of-month phase; cosmetic.
strengths: Physically based single-scattering sky LUT (Rayleigh/Mie/ozone) feeding PMREM: sky colour, sun aureole and 17:30 horizon haze are right; IBL on the sphere ladder matches the sky
Correct sun path east->south->west computed locally and published; core sunAzimuth bug documented in docs/core-requests/environment.md rather than worked around silently
CSM 3x2048 PCF with fade and camera-adaptive maxFar: soft, correctly placed contact shadows at all times; sun->moon switch keeps shadows at night
Per-window random warm/cool night lights with reveals on the showcase towers; the night frames are the most CS2-like output
Weather: five presets, ?weather honoured at boot, setWeather with clamping and weather:changed events, wetness dynamics, sun-projected cloud shadows, GPU-only rain in one draw

Hygiene: only this module adds lights or touches renderer state; 10 draws vs 15 budget; 0.3 ms update; zero errors and zero NaNs across the clock; deterministic; rng-only randomness; CC0 assets in the manifest
